publication_text: Anthropic, “DXC will integrate Claude into the systems banks, airlines, and other regulated industries rely on,” June 11, 2026, section “Building a team of Claude-certified engineers.” Official announcement. Talent selection, supplementary courses, and plan status are publicly described arrangements, not independently verified outcomes.

DXC, “DXC and Anthropic Announce Multi-Year Global Alliance to Bring AI into Mission-Critical Enterprise Systems,” June 11, 2026, main text and “Forward-Deployed Engineers” section. Official announcement. Ninety days was the training and certification path described at the time; “Customer Zero” is the company's terminology.

DXC Investor Day 2026 Transcript, June 11, 2026, PDF pp. 5, 7, and 60. Official transcript. Page 60 explicitly includes DXC itself in the count of 57. Initial training in July was a plan on that date; this chapter makes no judgment about subsequent execution.

DXC, Investor Day 2026 Presentation, PDF p. 72 and footnotes on p. 75. Investor presentation material; the official PDF was obtained again on September 9, 2026. Targets, timed analyses, and production telemetry should be understood as different evidentiary bases.
